item.title: Maw Sit Sit: Lapidary Tips
item.description: Maw Sit Sit is a rare, electrifying green stone. It is only found in the surrounding region of the village of Tawmaw, north of Myanmar. Sometimes called “Chrome Jade,” many believe this stone to be a type of jade or jadeite. Instead, it’s a metamorphic stone comprised of kosmochlor, clinochlore, albite and many other minerals. item.title: Seraphinite – What to Cut
item.description: Seraphinite is a form of clinochlore, a member of the chlorite group. The Lake Baikal region of eastern Siberia is the only place it is found.
